penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Delivering a governor-limit workaround pattern or consulting service requires per-engagement code review and custom Apex architecture work that cannot be automated by Claude alone at sufficient quality for a paid product.

rationale: Salesforce governor-limit pain is real and recurring for devs with large data volumes, and the buyer (a dedicated Salesforce developer at a mid-market company) has organizational budget. However, the solution space is either a documentation/pattern guide (low WTP, free substitutes exist on Trailhead and Stack Exchange) or a consulting engagement (requires per-customer human work). Neither can be delivered autonomously at scale by Claude. Signal strength is low (single instance), and the operational autonomy is too low for the factory model.
solution_plan: This does not fit the factory model. The problem demands either a reference guide (essentially free content that competes with Salesforce's own documentation) or custom Apex code review and architecture consulting — both require per-customer human judgment. Claude could assist a developer in solving this, but not deliver a productized, self-serve service to Salesforce developers autonomously. Pass.
notes: operational_autonomy score of 4 fails the build gate (min: 7). buildability_with_ai score of 5 fails the build gate (min: 6). Total below validate threshold of 5.5 after penalties.
